brief.title: Student Performance Analytics Report: Factors Influencing Academic Outcomes in Bangladesh
brief.one_liner: A comprehensive analysis of academic, socio-economic, and environmental factors affecting student performance across districts in Bangladesh.
brief.goal: Identify the key drivers of student academic success (SSC and HSC results), uncover disparities across demographic and socio-economic segments, and provide evidence-based recommendations for targeted educational interventions.

required_sections.title: Student Demographic Overview
required_sections.objective: Summarize the composition of the student population by gender, age, district, and school type, providing context for subsequent analyses.

required_sections.title: Academic Performance Analysis
required_sections.objective: Analyze the distribution and central tendencies of Previous GPA, SSC Result, and HSC Result, including performance classification (Excellent/Good/Average/Poor) and pass/fail rates.

required_sections.title: Socio-Economic Factors and Their Impact on Performance
required_sections.objective: Examine how family income, parent education level, internet access, and private tuition correlate with student academic outcomes.

required_sections.title: Study Behavior and Attendance Patterns
required_sections.objective: Investigate the relationship between study hours per week, attendance rates, and academic results to identify optimal study patterns.

required_sections.title: Regional Performance Disparities
required_sections.objective: Compare academic performance across districts and school types (public vs. private) to highlight geographic and institutional inequalities.

required_sections.title: Key Findings and Policy Recommendations
required_sections.objective: Synthesize insights into actionable recommendations for educators, administrators, and policymakers to improve student outcomes.

kpis.name: Average HSC Result
kpis.description: Mean HSC GPA across all students, serving as the primary outcome metric (scale 0–5).

kpis.name: Excellent Performance Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of students achieving an HSC GPA of 4.5 or above, indicating top-tier academic achievement.

kpis.name: At-Risk Student Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of students with an HSC GPA below 3.0, identifying those who may need additional support.

kpis.name: GPA Progression Delta
kpis.description: Average difference between HSC Result and Previous GPA, indicating whether students are improving or declining over time.

kpis.name: Attendance-Performance Correlation
kpis.description: Correlation coefficient between attendance percentage and HSC Result, quantifying the strength of attendance as a predictor.
